chunks: Therefore they will be screened off from their Lord that day,

key_terms.يَوْمَئِذٍ: on that day (referring to the Day of Judgment)

ai.seo_question: What does it mean that disbelievers will be 'mahjubun' (screened off) from their Lord on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah al-Mutaffifin is often linked with its counterpart in Surah Al-Imran (3:55) to illustrate the dual reality of divine veiling (hijab) for the unjust and unveiling for the righteous. The 'screening' is not merely physical but signifies a spiritual barrier caused by the accumulation of sins, preventing the perception of divine proximity. This concept underscores the Shia emphasis on the consequences of moral negligence in determining one's ultimate spiritual state.
